understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by positioning the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with '+' in the semantic grid is occupied simultaneously; completing all levels (reaching a WIN state) would complete the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempted to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction; movement could be blocked by walls/boundaries or by adjacent objects, though the blocked hints were only heuristic and not a guarantee. Some adjacent objects (blocks) could be pushable, moving along with the selected piece if pushed into empty space. When multiple selectable pieces existed, CLICK on a selectable's pixel position switched which piece was controlled.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to solve each level by positioning the selectable piece(s) so that every goal tile marked with '+' in the semantic grid is occupied simultaneously; completing all levels (reaching a WIN state) would complete the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempted to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction; movement could be blocked by walls/boundaries or by adjacent objects, though the blocked hints were only heuristic and not a guarantee. Some adjacent objects (blocks) could be pushable, moving along with the selected piece if pushed into empty space. When multiple selectable pieces existed, CLICK on a selectable's pixel position switched which piece was controlled.
